test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If 370 students appeared for an examination, of which 352 passed, then the find the pass percentage (approximate).
solution:
**Given:**

No of students = 370 

No of students passed = 352 

**Formula used:**

Pass percentage = No of students passed/Total students × 100 

**Calculation:**

∴ Pass percentage = 352/370 × 100 

⇒ 95.13% 

**⇒ 95% (Approximately)**
